title: 4-Day Small Group Tour: Yellowstone and Tetons Camping from Salt Lake City
includes: Live commentary is provided in English.
All camping equipment except your sleeping bag (rent a sleeping bag with advance notice)
National park entry fees (excludes additional non US resident government fees if applicable)
App with tour commentary in French, German, Spanish, Italian, Korean, Japanese, Chinese
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
We provide booster seats for children 7-8 years old.
Children must be 7 years and older to join.

Camping accommodation is a solo or 2-person tent. If you are traveling as a couple or as a group of four or more, please advise this at the time of booking in the Special Requirements box so accommodations can be made to keep your party together.
Campsites used are typically equipped with Wi-Fi, laundry and hot showers, and some may have outdoor hot tubs and swimming pools.
Vegetarian meals are available upon request.
New Tour Option- Purchase 8 seats and have a fully private tour.
This tour has a free downloadable App with tour commentary in French, German, Spanish and Italian.
All camping equipment-fully sanitized between tours.
Please Note: National Park fees may apply for international visitors. If applicable, this fee is collected in-destination and not at the time of booking.
cancellation:
If you cancel at least 3 full day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a full refund.
If you cancel within 3 day(s) of the scheduled departure, you will receive a 0% refund.
blurb:
This 4-day camping tour spends time exploring Yellowstone National Park and the Grand Tetons with an experienced and fun local guide. Enjoying camping inside the National Parks, superb wildlife viewing opportunities as well as chances to go hiking. This is a small groups tour with a maximum of 13 guests per tour.

Immerse yourself in the beautiful night skies of the Western USA! Get ready to gaze up at the awe-inspiring starry skies above you! Spot the Milky Way and maybe even shooting stars, enjoy campfires, toasting s’mores over an open campfire, alfresco dining, and more on this true nature experience. Expert tour guide and all camping equipment supplied throughout.
